Maya (CS): kicking off onboarding with HaloHealth — quick sync on stakeholders, success metrics, and first 30-day timeline.
Raj (Sales): intro — they're starting prod trials next week. Sponsor: Priya (CTO).
Olivia (CSM): scheduling kickoff Wed 10am PT; sending invite now.
Sam (Eng): we'll need API token, model pin, and CORS details by Mon.
Diego (Solutions): integration scope = chat + embeddings for search; will share ingestion doc.
Maya (CS): success criteria:
- <300ms avg search latency
- embedding recall >0.85 on pilot eval set
- 3 power users onboarded in 30d
- 100k docs ingested
Raj (Sales): renewal note — renewal window in ~11 months; upsell cadence post-pilot.
Olivia (CSM): enablement plan: 2 workshops (data & ingestion; API/security) + playbook + async walkthroughs.
Sam (Eng): I can run the API/security workshop.
Diego (Solutions): I'll run data & ingestion.
Maya (CS): feedback capture: short NPS + 6-question survey after week 1; add tracking in Gainsight.
Olivia (CSM): invite list: Priya (CTO), Amir (Head of Data), Nora (SRE), Jen (Product). Adding them now.
OnboardBot: onboarding checklist created — https://redwood.onboard/halohealth (status: draft)
Maya (CS): ACTIONS:
- Olivia: send invite and survey template (EOD)
- Sam: share auth steps + example curl (tomorrow)
- Diego: post ingestion doc + sample mapping
- Raj: share contract renewal timeline with upsell notes
Olivia (CSM): noted, will update playbook and post here once ready.
Raj (Sales): LGTM. excited to get this moving :rocket:
Maya (CS): thanks — we'll reconvene after kickoff to capture risks and next 60d milestones. Keep replies in-thread :thumbsup:
